{{Short description|American mathematics award}}
{{Use mdy dates|date=December 2021}}
The '''Frederic Esser Nemmers Prize in Mathematics''' is awarded biennially from [[Northwestern University]]. It was initially endowed along with a companion prize, the [[Erwin Plein Nemmers Prize in Economics]], as part of a $14 million donation from the Nemmers brothers. They envisioned creating an award that would be as prestigious as the Nobel Prize. To this end, the majority of the income earned from the endowment is returned to the principal to increase the size of the award.

As of 2023, the award carries a $300,000 stipend and the scholar spends several weeks in residence at Northwestern University.<ref name="Nemmers_math">{{cite web|url=http://www.nemmers.northwestern.edu/mathematics.html |title=The Frederic Esser Nemmers Prize in Mathematics |publisher=[[Northwestern University]] |accessdate=September 11, 2023}}</ref>

Following recipients received this award:<ref name="Nemmers_math"/><ref name="Maths History">{{cite web | title=Nemmers Prize | website=Maths History | url=https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Honours/NemmersPrize/ | access-date=December 14, 2021}}</ref>

*1994 [[Yuri I. Manin]]
*1996 [[Joseph B. Keller]] 
*1998 [[John H. Conway]]
*2000 [[Edward Witten]]
*2002 [[Yakov G. Sinai]] 
*2004 [[Mikhail Gromov (mathematician)|Mikhail Gromov]]
*2006 [[Robert Langlands]] 
*2008 [[Simon Donaldson]]
*2010 [[Terence Tao]]
*2012 [[Ingrid Daubechies]]
*2014 [[Michael J. Hopkins]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://news.northwestern.edu/stories/2014/06/nemmers-mathematics-prize-michael-hopkins/|title=Harvard Professor Receives Nemmers Mathematics Prize|website=news.northwestern.edu|accessdate=December 14, 2021}}</ref>
*2016 [[János Kollár]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nemmers.northwestern.edu/prizes/2016kollar.html|title=2016 Frederic Esser Nemmers Mathematics Prize Recipient: Nemmers Prize – Northwestern University|website=www.nemmers.northwestern.edu|accessdate=December 14, 2021}}</ref>
*2018 [[Assaf Naor]]<ref name="Math">{{cite web | title=Professor Assaf Naor Awarded 2018 Nemmers Prize | website=Math | url=https://www.math.princeton.edu/news/professor-assaf-naor-awarded-2018-nemmers-prize | access-date=14 December 2021}}</ref>
*2020 [[Nalini Anantharaman]]<ref name="University of Strasbourg 2017">{{cite web | title=Single news – USIAS | website=University of Strasbourg | date=14 November 2017 | url=https://www.usias.fr/en/news-events/news/single-news/article/le-prix-nemmers-de-mathematiques-2020-a-ete-decerne-a-nalini-anantharaman/ | access-date=14 December 2021}}</ref>
*2022 [[Bhargav Bhatt (mathematician)|Bhargav Bhatt]]<ref>[https://www.nemmers.northwestern.edu/mathematics.html Laureate 2022]</ref>
